QuestInfo.name: [Limina] As Decreed
QuestInfo.0: You and Orchid defeated the #rBlack Mage#k!! Unfortunately, you were exposed to the Light of Annihilation.
QuestInfo.1: To your surprise, the #bWhite Mage#k appeared before you and spoke with you for a while. When you finally regained consciousness, you found yourself outside the Giant's Heart.
QuestInfo.2: You evaded the Giant's attack and arrived back on the ship much to Empress Cygnus's relief.
